hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -f pyproject.toml ] || exit 0; out=$( (uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest -q) 2>&1 ) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; echo 'Commit blocked: ruff, mypy and pytest must all pass (CLAUDE.md, Definition of done).' >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running ruff, mypy and pytest before commit...
